stations.title: Ailsa
stations.say: How long will the radio last?
stations.note: All night at the radio desk.

stations.title: Radio desk
stations.text: Each job stops the moment it is done.

captions: Saturday night on Stob Ruadh. Ailsa keeps the radio desk until the walker is found.
Today Dougie's countdown runs for ever, and nobody knows how long the radio will last.
You write while loops that stop when the job is done, with break and continue.
Now the countdown ends, the battery is counted, and the search stops at the right square.
Loops that run while something is true, and how to stop one that never ends.
